intro.en: Camille Arno is an elite Keeper from Seš'qa, skilled in blood-related Originium Arts and anti-witchcraft, who is seeking to work with Endfield Industries in a personal capacity.
intro.zh-TW: 卡繆·亞爾諾是來自塞什卡的頂尖看護人，精於血液源石技藝與反制巫術，正以個人身分尋求與終末地工業合作。

basic.en: Heat combo of up to 5 hits. As the controlled operator, his final strike also deals 18 Stagger.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 5 段的灼熱傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊會額外造成 18 點失衡。

battle.en: Firefang Vesperwings deal small-area Heat damage and Heat Infliction, then hover on the target to inflict Weakness and Heat Susceptibility, jumping to another nearby enemy on defeat with the same effects. Hitting a hovered enemy with Camille's combo skill triggers a delayed Heat explosion.
battle.zh-TW: 召喚銜火血翼對小範圍造成灼熱傷害與灼熱附著，隨後盤桓於目標身旁施加虛弱與灼熱脆弱；目標被擊敗時會轉移至附近另一敵人並再次造成上述效果。以卡繆的連攜技命中被盤桓目標時，短暫延遲後會觸發爆裂造成額外灼熱傷害。

combo.en: Trigger: an enemy's Heat Infliction is consumed or absorbed. He dashes out and back, dealing Heat damage and recovering SP.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：有敵人的灼熱附著被消耗或吸收。來回穿梭攻擊，造成灼熱傷害並回復一定技力。

ultimate.en: He leaps to rain down spears and sweep through enemies for Heat damage, Heat Infliction, and SP recovery. For a time afterward, his next battle skill becomes Hunter Pursuit, a free dash counted as a combo skill that deals Heat damage and recovers SP.
ultimate.zh-TW: 升空降下槍雨並銜接橫掃，造成灼熱傷害、施加灼熱附著並回復一定技力。施放後一段時間內，下一次戰技會替換為視為連攜技且不消耗技力的追獵，來回穿梭造成灼熱傷害並回復技力。

talents.en: When Heartstake Thorn hits an enemy hovered by Firefang Vesperwings, Camille heals himself for 30 + Intellect × 0.15 HP (60 + Intellect × 0.3 at Promotion II) and gains Link for 15 s. Hunter Pursuit triggers this even without hovering Vesperwings.
talents.zh-TW: 錐心之棘命中受銜火血翼盤桓的敵人時，回復自身 30 + 智識 × 0.15 生命值（精英化II 為 60 + 智識 × 0.3）並獲得連擊，持續 15 秒；施放追獵時無需盤桓即可觸發。

talents.en: Whenever Camille heals himself with a skill, he gains +2% Heat damage (+4% at Promotion III) for 40 s, up to 5 stacks, while other teammates gain 25% of this bonus. If he is already at full HP, each trigger grants 2 stacks.
talents.zh-TW: 透過技能回復自身生命值時，自身獲得 2% 灼熱傷害加成（精英化III 為 4%），持續 40 秒，最多 5 層，其餘隊友獲得此效果的 25%。生命值已滿時，每次觸發直接獲得 2 層。

potentials.en: Blazing Exorcism adds +5% Weakness and +5% Heat Susceptibility, and Firefang Vesperwings hover 15 s longer.
potentials.zh-TW: 驅火焚影施加的虛弱與灼熱脆弱效果各 +5%，銜火血翼的盤桓時間 +15 秒。

potentials.en: Heartstake Thorn has 2 s shorter cooldown, while both Heartstake Thorn and Hunter Pursuit deal 1.3 times damage and recover 1.15 times SP.
potentials.zh-TW: 錐心之棘冷卻時間 -2 秒，且錐心之棘與追獵的傷害倍率提升為 1.3 倍、技力回復量提升為 1.15 倍。

potentials.en: Sanguine Downpour costs 15% less Ultimate Energy.
potentials.zh-TW: 猩紅墜雨所需的終結技能量 -15%。

potentials.en: Bloodfount Revival increases its Heat damage bonus per stack by +6%.
potentials.zh-TW: 血湧甦生每層提供的灼熱傷害加成額外 +6%。
